visualApproval.basis: Actual visual inspection of all 56 pages in Poppler and Apple PDFKit contact sheets. Changed setup/package/changelog pages were inspected individually in both engines. All chapter openers and selected dense/diagram/code pages were inspected on native-resolution paired sheets without resizing.
checks: Cover, contents, all chapter openers, workflow diagrams, dense tables, prompt panels, code blocks, references, and the final changelog are legible and complete.
The paid/Education plan prerequisite and separate reader-owned Figma import guidance fit within the existing page layout.
No visible clipping, overlapping text, missing glyphs, broken table rows, or missing artwork were found.
Pages 41–42 preserve the intact three-line command panel and final padding; pages 54–55 show the correct running headers.
The complete accepted one-group changelog occupies the final page 56 with the prior edition identity and exact prior PDF hash.
visualApproval.paginationObservation: Page 52 contains a short readable capstone continuation; it is accepted as part of the governing pagination.
visualApproval.limitations: This approval binds only the exact PDF bytes and their visual presentation. Public reader, package, publication and deployment acceptance have separate evidence.
